summary: KBS Real Estate Investment Trust III filed an 8-K on October 30, 2026, reporting a sixth modification of its Accenture Tower loan facility with U.S. Bank, Bank of America, Deutsche Pfandbriefbank and National Bank of Kuwait. The maturity date was extended to December 17, 2026, with a further option to extend to November 2, 2027, contingent on conditions and a $0.4 million extension fee. Effective November 2, 2026, the loan bears interest at one-month Term SOFR plus 325 basis points. This is a routine debt modification, not a special situation; watch refinancing risk as the near-term maturity looms.
